app.name: Attendance Manager
app.offline_note: Works offline. Your data stays on this computer. Version {version}

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: An overview of attendance for the selected course.

courses.title: Courses
courses.subtitle: Each course and section keeps its own students and attendance.

sessions.title: Attendance Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Every uploaded attendance file is kept as its own session.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Everyone on the master list with their cumulative attendance.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Professional Excel reports, ready to print or share.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Preferences for how attendance is evaluated and protected.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.subtitle: Keep a safe copy of all courses, attendance and original files.

dashboard.welcome_text: Start by creating a course and uploading its master student list (for example 00.xls). Then add each week's attendance file — the dashboard updates automatically.
dashboard.no_sessions_text: {students} enrolled in {course}. Upload the first weekly attendance file (for example 11.xls) to see statistics here.
dashboard.trend_subtitle: Share of students present in each lecture.
dashboard.distribution_subtitle: How many students fall in each attendance range.

list.most_absent_subtitle: Students who missed the most lectures.

courses.empty_text: Create a course for each class and section you teach. You will need its master student list (for example 00.xls).
courses.all_archived: All your courses are archived. Tick “Show archived courses” to see them.

sessions.no_course_text: Attendance sessions belong to a course. Create a course first.
sessions.empty_text: Upload a weekly attendance file (for example 11.xls). Each upload becomes a session that is stored permanently and can be opened at any time.
sessions.footer_note: Removing a session only excludes it from the statistics. It stays stored and can be restored at any time. Attendance results themselves can never be edited.

students.no_course_text: Students come from a course's master list. Create a course to get started.
students.search_placeholder: Search by name, student ID or any detail…   (Ctrl+F)

reports.full_subtitle: One Excel workbook (.xlsx) with seven sheets:

sheet_desc.summary: Course details, key figures, every session and charts.
sheet_desc.cumulative: Every student with all master-file details, present, absent, % and status.
sheet_desc.by_session: A grid of P / A for every student in every lecture, with totals.
sheet_desc.absence_ranking: Students ordered from most to fewest absences.
sheet_desc.highest: Students ordered from best to lowest attendance.
sheet_desc.at_risk: Students below your at-risk and warning limits.
sheet_desc.details: One row per student per session — ideal for filtering in Excel.

reports.language_note: Sheet names and headings follow the interface language. Student names, IDs, file names and imported data are kept exactly as they are.
reports.single_text: Open any session under Attendance Sessions and choose “Export session to Excel” for a one-lecture list of present and absent students.
reports.offline_note: Reports are created on this computer only. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
reports.no_course: Create a course first to generate a report.

report.title: Attendance Report
report.grid_legend: P = present, A = absent, — = not enrolled at the time
report.at_risk_note: Students whose attendance is below {at_risk}%. Students between {at_risk}% and {warning}% are listed under “Warning”.
report.no_at_risk: No students are currently at risk.

kpi.with_absences: Students with at least one absence

settings.language_subtitle: Choose the interface language. The change applies immediately and is remembered.
settings.limits_subtitle: Used for the status labels, the dashboard and the reports.
settings.limits_invalid: ⚠  The at-risk limit must not be higher than the warning limit.
settings.limits_hint: Perfect = 100% · Good = {warning}% or more · Warning = {at_risk}% to {warning}% · At risk = below {at_risk}%
settings.backups_subtitle: A full backup is made once a day when you open the app.
settings.storage_subtitle: All data stays on this computer. No internet connection is used.

backup.create_text: Saves everything — courses, students, every attendance session and the original Excel files — into a single .zip file. Keep it on a USB drive or another safe place.
backup.restore_text: Replaces the current data with the contents of a backup file. A safety backup of the current data is made automatically first, so nothing is lost.
backup.history_text: Automatic backups and safety copies made before restoring or deleting.
backup.never: No backup has been made yet.

archive.title: Archive this course?
archive.message: “{course}” will be hidden from the course list. All its data is kept and you can restore it at any time from Courses → Show archived courses.

delete.title: Delete this course permanently?
delete.message: “{course}” with {students} and {sessions} will be deleted. Consider archiving instead.
delete.details: A full backup is created automatically before deleting, so it can be recovered from Backup & Restore.

restore.title: Restore this backup?
restore.message: All current data will be replaced by the backup from {when} ({courses}, {sessions}).
restore.details: A safety backup of your current data is created first, so you can undo this.

remove_session.title: Remove session
remove_session.prompt:
“{session}” ({date}) will no longer count in the statistics.
It stays stored and can be restored at any time.

Reason (optional):

toast.select_course_detail: Open a course, then add its attendance.
toast.course_is_archived_detail: Restore it from the Courses page to add attendance.
toast.session_saved_detail: {present} present · {absent} absent. The dashboard is up to date.
toast.backup_restored_detail: Your previous data was saved as {file}.

columns.title: Which column holds the student ID?
columns.intro_roster: We could not be completely sure how “{file}” is organized. Check the highlighted columns below. Students are matched with the weekly attendance files by their student ID — e-mail addresses such as 202400123@university.edu also work.
columns.intro_attendance: We could not be completely sure how “{file}” is organized. Check the highlighted columns below. Students are matched with the master student list by their student ID — e-mail addresses such as 202400123@university.edu also work.
columns.status_none: ⚠  No student IDs found in the selected column.
columns.status_found: ✓  {found} of {total} rows in the selected column contain a student ID.

roster.source: From “{file}” (sheet “{sheet}”). Student ID column: “{id_column}” · Name column: “{name_column}” · Columns: {columns}

course_dialog.name: Course name *
course_dialog.drop_hint: This is the file with every enrolled student (for example 00.xls). Drag it here or browse for it.

attendance.drop_hint: For example 11.xls exported from Microsoft Teams. Students in the file are marked present; everyone else on the master list is marked absent.
attendance.override: I understand this file was already uploaded — save it again as a new session
attendance.nothing_saved: Nothing is saved until you click “Save attendance”.
attendance.date_not_found: Date not found in the file — please check

student_dialog.inactive: This student is no longer on the current master list. Their attendance history is kept.
student_dialog.info_subtitle: Everything recorded for this student in the master file.
student_dialog.history_subtitle: Present or absent in every recorded lecture.
student_dialog.no_history: No attendance has been recorded for this course yet.

session_dialog.subtitle: {date} · original file “{file}” · uploaded {uploaded}
session_dialog.removed_banner: This session is removed from the statistics but kept in history. You can restore it from the Attendance Sessions page.
session_dialog.readonly_banner: This is the stored historical record. Viewing it never changes it.
session_dialog.open_original_tooltip: Opens a copy of the uploaded file in Excel

roster_dialog.title: Update the master student list
roster_dialog.subtitle: {course}. New students are added and details are refreshed. Nobody is deleted and past attendance is never changed.
roster_dialog.drop_hint: The same kind of file you used when creating the course (e.g. 00.xls).
roster_dialog.summary: {added} · {updated} · {unchanged} unchanged · {missing} no longer on the list
roster_dialog.deactivate: Mark the {students} no longer on the list as not enrolled (they won't be counted in future sessions; their history is kept)

edit_session.title: Session title and date
edit_session.note: Attendance results of this session are not changed.

notices.exact_duplicate: This exact file was already uploaded as “{session}”{state} on {date}. Saving it again would count that lecture twice.
notices.is_master_list: This is the master student list, not a weekly attendance file. Every student would be marked present.
notices.nobody_matched: None of the students on this course's master list were found in this file. Check that you picked the right course and file.
notices.mostly_unknown: Most people in this file are not on this course's master list. Is this the right course?
notices.same_students: Exactly the same students were present in “{session}”. Make sure this is not the same lecture uploaded twice.
notices.same_name: A different file with the same name was uploaded before (“{session}”).
notices.same_date: “{session}” is already recorded on this date.

unmatched.one: {count} person in the file is not on the master list (for example the instructor or guests). They are listed but not counted.
unmatched.other: {count} people in the file are not on the master list (for example the instructor or guests). They are listed but not counted.

repeated.one: {count} student appears more than once in the file (e.g. re-joined); each is counted once.
repeated.other: {count} students appear more than once in the file (e.g. re-joined); each is counted once.

notes.no_id_column: No column containing student IDs could be found automatically.
notes.ambiguous: More than one column contains ID-like numbers. Please confirm which one holds the student ID.
notes.few_ids: Only a few rows contain recognizable student IDs.
notes.some_ids: Some rows do not contain a recognizable student ID.
notes.no_header: No header row was found; columns were identified from their contents.

warn.no_id: Row {row}: no student ID — row skipped.
warn.not_id: Row {row}: “{value}” does not look like a student ID — row skipped.
warn.duplicate: Row {row}: student ID {id} appears more than once (first on row {first}); the first entry is used.
warn.no_name_column: No student name column was found. Names will be shown as “(no name)”.

title.original_not_opened: The original file could not be opened
title.session_not_exported: The session could not be exported
title.report_not_created: The report could not be created
title.file_unusable: This file could not be used
title.roster_not_updated: The student list was not updated

errors.unexpected:
An unexpected problem occurred. Your saved data is safe.

If this keeps happening, please send the log file (Settings → Open logs folder) to support.
errors.schema_too_new:
This data was created by a newer version of Attendance Manager.

Please install the latest version of Attendance Manager.
errors.schema_too_new_detail: This data was created by a newer version of Attendance Manager (schema {schema}).
errors.page_refresh_title: This page could not be refreshed
errors.page_refresh_detail: Your data is safe. See the log file for details.
errors.original_missing: The stored original file is missing or was modified.
errors.course_has_no_students: “{course}” has no students. Upload the master student list first.
errors.duplicate_session: This file was already uploaded as “{session}” ({date}). Uploading it again would count the same lecture twice.
errors.session_title_too_long: The session title is too long (120 characters maximum).
errors.roster_changed: The student list of this course changed. Please upload the file again.
errors.file_changed: The file changed on disk after it was checked. Please upload it again.
errors.report_locked: “{file}” could not be saved. If it is open in Excel, close it and try again.

course.name_too_long: The course name is too long (150 characters maximum).
course.duplicate: A course with the same name, section, semester and year already exists.
course.duplicate_other: Another course with the same name, section, semester and year already exists.

settings.thresholds: Attendance limits must be between 0 and 100, and the at-risk limit must not be higher than the warning limit.

backup.verify_failed: The backup file could not be verified after writing.
backup.write_failed: The backup could not be written to “{path}”.
backup.missing: The backup file “{file}” does not exist.
backup.not_backup_or_damaged: “{file}” is not an Attendance Manager backup or is damaged.
backup.not_backup: “{file}” is not an Attendance Manager backup.
backup.newer_version: This backup was made by a newer version of Attendance Manager. Please update first.
backup.corrupt_member: The backup is damaged (file “{file}” is corrupt).
backup.unsafe: The backup contains unsafe file paths and was rejected.
backup.no_database: The backup does not contain a database.
backup.checksum: The backup database failed its checksum. The backup is damaged.
backup.db_damaged: The database inside the backup is damaged.
backup.restore_failed: The backup could not be restored. Your data was not changed.

import.not_found: The file “{file}” could not be found.
import.too_large: The file “{file}” is too large to be an attendance sheet.
import.locked: The file “{file}” could not be opened. Close it in Excel and try again.
import.no_data: The file “{file}” does not contain any data.
import.password: “{file}” is password-protected. Remove the password in Excel and try again.
import.invalid_xls: “{file}” is not a valid Excel file or is damaged.
import.invalid_xlsx: “{file}” is damaged or is not a valid Excel (.xlsx) file.
import.binary: This file is not a spreadsheet (it looks like a binary file).
import.no_sheet: The selected sheet does not exist in this file.
import.no_column: The selected student ID column does not exist in this sheet.
import.no_students: No students were found in this file. Make sure it is the master student list and that the student ID column is selected correctly.
import.detect_failed: The student ID column could not be detected automatically. Please choose it manually.
